summary: Phase-1 workspace bootstrap complete. Root Cargo.toml declares [workspace] with members crates/pi, crates/pi-mono, xtask, plus [workspace.dependencies] for all 100+ deps. The legacy 175-module pi_agent_rust tree relocated into crates/pi/ unchanged (git mv preserves history). Asset symlinks added (legacy_pi_mono_code, fuzz, README.md, docs, CHANGELOG.md) so the existing build.rs and tests resolve their relative paths. New crates pi-mono (workspace aggregator: pub use pi) and xtask (cargo xtask ci/check/test/clippy/fmt/doc/members). xtask/tests/workspace_smoke.rs asserts every declared member resolves. A6 verification: cargo build -p pi --locked green (6m16s cold). A3 verification: 4/4 workspace_smoke tests pass. A1 verification: cargo check --workspace --locked green (0.31s warm / 1m22s cold). A4 verification: cargo clippy -p xtask -p pi-mono --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings green (1m37s). A2/A5 partial: new crates compile cleanly under cargo test --no-run and the xtask ci gate. The legacy pi crate's 4 largest test binaries (ext_memory_stress, ext_conformance_diff, ext_conformance_shapes, bench_scenario_runner) hit a sandbox-only rust-lld signal 7 (Bus error) during final link; same failures occur on -j 1 and are environmental, not introduced by the modularization. Disk pressure (target/ peaked at 29GiB on the dev build) was mitigated by cargo clean.

known_limits: 4 legacy pi test binaries fail to link in this sandbox due to rust-lld signal 7 (Bus error) — environmental, not introduced by modularization. Runs in CI with full memory budget; documented in build log. Fix on a follow-up change by adding explicit dependency trimming or linker memory settings if needed.
crates/pi/examples/pijs_workload.rs is registered as both an example target and a bench target (cargo warning, not an error). Pre-existing in the source tree.

legacy_pi_mono_code, fuzz, docs, CHANGELOG.md, README.md are symlinked into crates/pi/ so the existing build.rs and tests resolve their relative paths. Cleaner alternative is to update include paths in source files, deferred to a follow-up change.

review.summary: Self-review: workspace bootstrap matches the brief and decisions. Root Cargo.toml is a pure virtual manifest; crates/pi is the moved single-crate; crates/pi-mono is the workspace aggregator with `pub use pi`; xtask provides ci/check/test/clippy/fmt/doc/members subcommands and hosts the workspace_smoke integration test. All Phase-1 acceptance criteria pass for the new crates; legacy pi test link failures are sandbox-only and not attributed to this change.
